three-dimensional, approximately uniform colour space produced by plotting in rectangular coordinates stem:[L]*, stem:[a]*, stem:[b]*, quantities defined by the equations:
  • stem:[[[L,*,=,116,f,( Y // Y_n ),-,16],[a,*,=,500,f ( X // X_n ) - f ( Y // Y_n )],[b,*,=,200,f ( Y // Y_n ) - f ( Z // Z_n )]]]
where
  • stem:[f ( X // X_n ) = ( X // X_n )^(1 // 3)]

    if stem:[( X // X_n ) > ( 6 // 29 )^3]

  • stem:[f ( Y // Y_n ) = ( Y // Y_n )^(1 // 3)]
